rank_definition: 1 plus number of strictly higher scores; exact ties share rank.

definitions.clean_seeds: All 250 uploaded rows cut at this seed, replayed over 100-999.
definitions.band_seeds: All 250 uploaded rows return HDR, replayed over 100-999.
definitions.candidate_window: Historical 150-seed slice: h0-h5 offsets 0/50/100/150/200/250; h6 override 25; h8 reconstructed at 240 under the new stride-30 layout. h7 all-HDR uses the full joined 300.
definitions.missing_archive: h9 has no task upload archive and zero valid experiments in the API. Actual submitted clean set and band cannot be reconstructed.
